subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as plugin-owned buffers for LINE/WhatsApp-style channels, as a generic channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred in favor of existing text debounce plus narrow channel fixes?
rationale: The remaining request changes agent turn boundaries, latency, config surface, and channel lifecycle semantics, so an automated fix should not choose the product/API boundary without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffers first in affected channel plugins, reusing shared helpers only where they avoid real duplication.

options.title: Design a generic coalescer
options.body: Create a broader channel SDK or gateway contract for media-aware batching before channel-specific implementations, accepting a larger API and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce and Telegram album handling as the supported behavior for now and handle only narrow channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffers first in affected channel plugins, reusing shared helpers only where they avoid real duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, and config compatibility, which are all tied to steipete’s recent cross-channel policy history.
